items.exampleEn: You need a passport to open a bank account.
Is there a cashpoint near here?
We bought some duty-free chocolate at the airport.
items.exampleZh: 我們在機場買了一些免稅巧克力。

items.exampleEn: The exchange rate changes every day.
This old coin is worth only a penny.
items.exampleZh: 這枚舊硬幣只值一便士。

items.exampleEn: My parents give me pocket money every week.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽每週給我零用錢。

items.exampleEn: Second-hand cars are much cheaper than new ones.
items.exampleZh: 二手車比新車便宜得多。

items.sentenceEn: The cashpoint at the station is out of order.

items.audioEn: The duty-free shops are after passport control, near Gate 5.
items.audioZh: 免稅店在護照查驗之後，靠近 5 號登機門。

items.sentenceEn: Some children save their pocket money for a new toy.
items.sentenceZh: 有些孩子會存零用錢買新玩具。

items.sentenceEn: You can find good second-hand clothes online.
items.sentenceZh: 你可以在網路上找到不錯的二手衣服。

items.stemEn: The ____ is good today, so I'll change my dollars into the local currency.
items.stemZh: 今天匯率不錯，所以我要把美元換成當地貨幣。

items.stemEn: I didn't spend a single ____ on the trip.
items.stemZh: 這趟旅行我一毛錢都沒花。

items.passageEn: When Maya was twelve, her parents opened a bank account for her. Every week, she put half of her pocket money into it. By sixteen, she had saved enough to buy a second-hand bicycle. Last summer, she traveled abroad for the first time. She checked the exchange rate online and took cash from a cashpoint at the airport. She did not buy anything at the duty-free shops because she wanted to save every penny. Her only treat was a takeaway pizza on the last night.
items.passageZh: Maya 十二歲時，爸媽替她開了一個銀行帳戶。每個星期，她把一半的零用錢存進去。到了十六歲，她存的錢已經夠買一輛二手腳踏車。去年夏天，她第一次出國旅行。她上網查了匯率，並在機場的提款機領了現金。她在免稅店什麼都沒買，因為她想省下每一分錢。她唯一犒賞自己的，是最後一晚的一份外帶披薩。

questions.questionZh: Maya 每個星期把多少零用錢存進帳戶？
旅行時，Maya 唯一犒賞自己的是什麼？

items.promptZh: 我在一家二手書店買了這本書。
referenceEn: I bought this book at a second-hand bookshop.
I got this book from a second-hand bookstore.
rubricZh: second-hand 表示「二手的」，放在名詞前
時態配合內容（例如說已經發生的事用過去式）

items.instructionZh: 用 bank account 造一個句子，說說你怎麼使用銀行帳戶。
referenceEn: I put part of my pay into my bank account every month.
I use my bank account to pay bills online.
rubricZh: bank account 表示「銀行帳戶」
可用 open／use a bank account、put money into… 等說法
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
